gloss: quick work; nimble technique; feat of speed

definitions.gloss: quick work; nimble technique; feat of speed
definitions.explanation: An action performed with impressive speed and skill. Used to describe someone completing a task remarkably fast, a quick sleight-of-hand trick, or a rapid technique in martial arts or sports.

examples.japanese: さすが⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早技|はやわざ}だ。
examples.english: That's impressive quick work — a true professional.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早技|はやわざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三品|さんぴん}⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: He whipped up three dishes with impressive speed.

examples.japanese: {手品師|てじなし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早技|はやわざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見張|みは}った→見張る：18224_miharu⟧。
examples.english: The audience was amazed by the magician's sleight of hand.

notes:
Combines {早|はや} (fast, quick) and ⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧ (technique, skill). Also written as {早業|はやわざ} with the same meaning. Carries a tone of admiration — the speed is not just fast but skillful.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早技|はやわざ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to finish something off quickly
- {早技|はやわざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show off quick work
- さすが⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早技|はやわざ}: impressive quick work (as expected)
- ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{早技|はやわざ}: splendid quick technique

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {荒技|あらわざ}: rough technique — impressive but forceful, not necessarily fast
- {離れ技|はなれわざ}: remarkable feat — emphasizes the difficulty rather than speed
- ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: deft, efficient — describes skillful handling of work, overlapping in meaning
